In this Orientation & Lecture 1 of the Mains Master Program (MMP) 2027, Santosh Sir will introduce the roadmap, approach, and strategy required for effective UPSC Mains preparation. The session will cover how aspirants should approach Mains answer writing, current affairs integration, syllabus coverage, and overall preparation planning for Mains 2027.
